title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior diffuses through a population over time under social influence, information campaigns, supply constraints, and policy mandates.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe mask use among their network neighbors and update their attitude/behavior via social learning or conformity.

interactions.name: information_exposure
interactions.description: People are exposed to messages from authorities and information sources; exposure updates beliefs based on credibility and prior attitudes.

interactions.name: purchase_masks
interactions.description: People attempt to buy masks from retailers subject to inventory, price, and willingness to pay.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Authorities and locations enforce mask mandates via checks, warnings, or fines with some detection probability.

interactions.name: location_entry_rule
interactions.description: Locations with requirements may deny entry or require compliance; affects observed behavior and social signals.

interactions.name: habit_and_fatigue_update
interactions.description: Repeated mask use strengthens habit; sustained use incurs fatigue, modifying compliance probability.

interactions.name: risk_feedback
interactions.description: Environmental risk level affects risk perception and thus adoption tendency.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of people wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_by_location_type
metrics.description: Mask usage conditional on being in specific location types (e.g., retail, transport).

metrics.name: time_to_threshold_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: mandate_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of people complying with mask requirements when mandates are active.

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_index
metrics.description: Disparity of adoption across demographic or income groups (e.g., Gini or variance).

metrics.name: inventory_stockouts
metrics.description: Count of retailer stockout events over time.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions
metrics.description: Number of warnings/fines issued under enforcement.

metrics.name: average_consumer_cost
metrics.description: Average cumulative spending on masks per person.
